answer: The bug was in the logic for generating the docstring description in `pass_meta_key`. The condition `if doc_description is not None:` was incorrect; it should have been `if doc_description is None:` to provide a default value when no custom description is provided. Additionally, I corrected the string formatting to include single quotes around the key name as expected by the test.

The bug was in the `pass_meta_key` decorator where it checked `if doc_description is not None:` instead of `if doc_description is None:`. This caused it to skip setting the default description when none was provided, leading to an incorrect docstring. I corrected the condition to `if doc_description is None:`.
